🚀 IT'S HERE! Keychron Nape Pro is officially on sale.

Co-developed with Gizmodo Japan, this wireless trackball mouse sits right below your spacebar, keeping your cursor close and your hands in the flow. Now it's time to make it yours!

📍 Below-spacebar design — less reaching, more flow.
⚙️ 6 customizable buttons and a programmable control dial — put your go-to actions within reach.
🧭 OctaShift — choose the angle that fits your setup.
🌐 ZMK customization in the Keychron Launcher web app — set it up your way.
🤫 Silent clicks — stay focused wherever you work.

Nape Pro is available now. Pick yours up today.

Keychron Q19 HE 8K: A 60% wired magnetic keyboard with a full aluminum body and aged finish.

🏆 A full aluminum body with a distinctive aged finish.
⌨️ Magnetic switches with an adjustable actuation point.
⚡ Rapid Trigger for faster, more intentional resets.
🚀 8,000Hz wired polling for near-instant response.
🎛️ Remap and personalize every key in Keychron Launcher.

Which Q19 HE detail earns a spot on your desk? Let us know below 👇
